_comment: The minimum Story Studio version a freshly shipped Store pack may require. This is the single source of truth: `npm run content-pack:ship` reads min_app_version from here and substitutes it for the {{MIN_APP_VERSION}} token in each pack.json. It is owner-editable data, not a constant in code. Raise it only when a new pack genuinely needs an app capability older builds lack, because every customer below the floor stops seeing packs shipped after the change. Already-published archives are immutable and are never affected by editing this file.
